messages:
Alex (AE): Kickoff — Velora Health POC. They want a 4-week pilot to validate 'triage + EHR summarization' flows. Need to align: success criteria, endpoints, prompt/eval plan, timeline, and security/pricing constraints. Can SE + Security triage ASAP? Timeline target: start Mon Apr 14 (4w). Key asks: which endpoints, sample prompts/evals, latency & cost SLOs, and whether Private/VPC required. CC @Meera @Marta

Meera (Solutions Eng): +1, I can take lead on use-case prioritization. My proposed MVP endpoints (ranked):
1) Triage classifier (intent + urgency)
2) EHR encounter summarization (single-note -> concise summary)
3) Context-aware assisted reply (compose reply drafts using patient context)

Meera (Solutions Eng): Quick notes on expected traffic and perf:
- Triage: avg payload ~200 tokens in + 50 tokens out, target p99 latency <200ms for hosted; if they need <100ms we should propose Dedicated
- Summaries: avg 2k input tokens -> streaming response, p95 <800ms on Dedicated; expect higher cost

Meera (Solutions Eng): Example eval snippet (we'll build a small prompt set of ~150 cases):
```
# triage prompt example
Patient note: \"Patient reports chest pain after exertion, shortness of breath.\"\nTask: classify urgency: {low, moderate, high}
```
Pass criteria: F1 >= 0.85 on high-urgency class; end-to-end latency <300ms for 95% of triage calls.

Jonathan (Customer Eng): Integration notes — they have a FHIR-backed EHR and want to call our REST endpoints from an internal service. Needs:
- Batch ingestion for nightly evals
- Webhook for async completed summaries
- Schema: include patient_id, encounter_id, provider_id in metadata (no PHI in logs)

Marta (Security): Security prelims — flagged items from legal/security review:
- PHI: must ensure data-in-transit & at-rest encrypted, and no PII persisted in hosted logs
- KMS/HSM: customer wants to use their own keys (bring-your-own KMS) for Private
- Audit logs & retention policy needed (they asked 13 months)
- Contract ask: SOC2 + HIPAA BA agreement

Marta (Security): Questions for SE/AE:
- Will any PHI be cached by default (prefix cache / KV cache)? If yes, need policy to disable for that customer or scrub
- Do we have endemic DLP integrations or do they need a customer-side proxy?

Alex (AE): For pricing — they expect to compare: hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved capacity. Initial traffic estimate:
- Triage: 100 reqs/min peak
- Summaries: 30 reqs/hour
Estimate monthly tokens ~200M. Can we get a rough hosted cost vs 1-GPU dedicated baseline? Also what are min contract terms for Dedicated?

Meera (Solutions Eng): Rough cost guidance: hosted ~ $0.0006 / token for heavy gen (placeholder) — this is ballpark. Dedicated: 1x A4000 equivalent baseline for this workload + autoscale; recommend 3-month pilot commit to get predictable perf. I'll get an engineering estimate.

Priya (Product): Pilot success metrics suggestion:
- Triage: precision@high >= 0.9 and mean latency <250ms
- Summaries: clinician-rated usefulness >= 4/5 on a 40-sample eval set
- Integration: webhook reliability 99.5% over trial
If those met, move to a 6-12 month reserved capacity conversation.

Meera (Solutions Eng): Proposed evaluation plan & owner:
- Build 150 triage prompts + 40 summarization gold notes (Owner: Meera)
- Run daily auto-evals and weekly manual clinician review (Owner: Velora + Jonathan)
- Ship a small client-side script to pseudonymize PHI before sending (Owner: Jonathan)

Alex (AE): Marta — can we get an initial \"barrier\" checklist we can share with Velora legal? They'll want to know if we can support BYOK, VPC peering, audit logs, BAAs, and retention controls.

Marta (Security): I'll draft a one-pager checklist. Quick answers: BYOK ✅ (Private), VPC peering ✅ (Private), Audit logs ✅ (with retention config), BAA — need legal sign-off but OK to pursue. Will call out DLP as TBD; recommend we propose a proxy pattern or client-side pseudonymization.

RG Deploy Bot: deploy-status: no infra change requested for POC. If SE wants Dedicated test, open infra ticket.

Alex (AE): Next steps:
- Meera: share prioritized eval prompts + rough perf/cost estimate by Thu
- Marta: security checklist draft by Fri
- Jonathan: brief on integration & pseudonymization approaches by Wed
- Priya: confirm pilot launch date and acceptance criteria by EOD

Priya (Product): Confirming pilot window: Apr 14 -> May 9 (4 weeks). We should schedule a kickoff with Velora + technical onboarding call Apr 15. :calendar:

Alex (AE): Thanks team — I'll sync with Velora and push the kickoff invite once we have Meera's prompt set. :thumbsup:
